name: Academic Excellence Scholarship
description: Supports students with strong academic performance, consistent grades, good academic progress, and strong overall educational achievement.

name: Extracurricular Achievement Scholarship
description: Supports students who demonstrate strong participation in extracurricular activities, leadership, student clubs, competitions, volunteering, and other activities outside the classroom.

name: Technology and Computing Scholarship
description: Supports students pursuing computing, software engineering, information systems, data science, information technology, and other technology-related academic fields.

name: Merit Scholarship
description: For students demonstrating a combination of strong academic performance, extracurricular involvement, academic progress, and consistent semester achievement.

name: Student Achievement Scholarship
description: Recognizes students who maintain good academic standing, complete their academic credits successfully, and demonstrate continued progress toward graduation.

name: Leadership and Community Scholarship
description: Supports students who demonstrate leadership, community participation, volunteering, teamwork, and meaningful extracurricular contributions.

name: STEM Excellence Scholarship
description: Supports students studying science, technology, engineering, mathematics, computing, and related technical disciplines who demonstrate strong academic achievement.

name: Academic Progress Scholarship
description: Supports students who maintain satisfactory academic progress, successfully complete their coursework, and consistently work toward their educational goals.

name: Future Innovator Scholarship
description: Supports students interested in innovation, technology, problem solving, research, new ideas, and developing solutions that can create positive impact.

name: All-Round Achievement Scholarship
description: Recognizes students with balanced academic achievement, extracurricular participation, successful coursework, and consistent overall student performance.
